Summary

CODATE01 is an online CICS program that acts as a message-driven date/time service. It retrieves incoming requests from an MQ input queue, obtains the current system date and time using CICS ASKTIME/FORMATTIME, and places a formatted response message containing the system date and time onto a reply queue. Any processing errors are routed to a dedicated error queue.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: None - **MQ Calls**: Yes - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Initialize working storage fields, clear queue names and message buffers to prepare for processing 2: Open Error Queue - Open the MQ error queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) for writing error messages that occur during processing 3: Retrieve Transaction Trigger Information - Retrieve the MQ trigger message from CICS to obtain the input queue name that initiated this transaction 4: Set Input and Reply Queue Names - Set the input queue name from the trigger message and assign the fixed reply queue name (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE) 5: Open Input Queue - Open the designated input MQ queue for reading incoming date request messages 6: Open Output/Reply Queue - Open the reply MQ queue (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE) for writing date/time response messages back to requestors 7: Get Request Message - Read the next available request message from the input MQ queue with a 5-second wait interval 8: Save Message Identifiers - Save the message ID, correlation ID, and reply-to queue from the incoming request message for use in the reply 9: Get Current System Date and Time - Retrieve the current system date and time using CICS ASKTIME to obtain the absolute timestamp 10: Format Date and Time - Format the absolute timestamp into MM-DD-YYYY date format and HH:MM:SS time format using CICS FORMATTIME 11: Build Date/Time Reply Message - Construct the reply message string containing the formatted system date and system time (e.g., 'SYSTEM DATE: MM-DD-YYYY SYSTEM TIME: HH:MM:SS') 12: Send Reply Message - Put the date/time reply message onto the output/reply MQ queue, correlating it back to the original request using saved message identifiers 13: Process Message Loop - Continuously retrieve and process date request messages from the input queue until no more messages are available 14: Commit Transaction - Issue a CICS syncpoint to commit each processed message transaction before retrieving the next message 15: Send Error Notification - When an error occurs, write the error details (error description, condition code, reason code, queue name) to the error queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) 16: Close Input Queue - Close the input MQ queue upon completion or error to release queue resources 17: Close Output/Reply Queue - Close the output/reply MQ queue upon completion or error to release queue resources 18: Close Error Queue - Close the error MQ queue upon completion or error to release queue resources 19: Program Termination - Return control to CICS after closing all open queues, ending the transaction

Datasource Information (3)

Datasource Name Type Usage
INPUT-QUEUE-NAME (retrieved from MQTM-QNAME via CICS RETRIEVE) MQ Queue Input queue from which date/time request messages are retrieved (MQGET)
CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE MQ Queue Reply/output queue to which formatted system date and time response messages are sent (MQPUT)
CARD.DEMO.ERROR MQ Queue Error queue to which error/exception messages are sent when processing failures occur (MQPUT)

MOVE 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' TO ERROR-QUEUE-NAME CALL 'MQOPEN' USING QMGR-HANDLE-CONN MQ-OBJECT-DESCRIPTOR MQ-OPTIONS MQ-HOBJ MQ-CONDITION-CODE MQ-REASON-CODE EVALUATE MQ-CONDITION-CODE WHEN MQCC-OK MOVE MQ-HOBJ TO ERROR-QUEUE-HANDLE SET ERR-QUEUE-OPEN TO TRUE WHEN OTHER MOVE ERROR-QUEUE-NAME TO MQ-APPL-QUEUE-NAME MOVE 'ERR MQOPEN ERR' TO MQ-APPL-RETURN-MESSAGE DISPLAY MQ-ERR-DISPLAY PERFORM 8000-TERMINATION END-EVALUATE. ``` Retrieve MQ Trigger Message to Determine Input Queue-L_3: ```cobol EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) RESP(WS-CICS-RESP1-CD) RESP2(WS-CICS-RESP2-CD) END-EXEC ``` Validate Trigger Message Retrieval Success-L_4: ```cobol IF WS-CICS-RESP1-CD = DFHRESP(NORMAL) MOVE MQTM-QNAME TO INPUT-QUEUE-NAME MOVE 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE' TO REPLY-QUEUE-NAME ELSE MOVE 'CICS RETRIEVE' TO MQ-ERROR-PARA MOVE WS-CICS-RESP1-CD TO WS-CICS-RESP1-CD-D MOVE WS-CICS-RESP2-CD TO WS-CICS-RESP2-CD STRING 'RESP: ', WS-CICS-RESP1-CD-D , WS-CICS-RESP2-CD-D, 'END' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO MQ-APPL-RETURN-MESSAGE END-STRING PERFORM 9000-ERROR PERFORM 8000-TERMINATION END-IF ``` Set Input and Reply Queue Names from Trigger-L_5: ```cobol MOVE MQTM-QNAME TO INPUT-QUEUE-NAME MOVE 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE' TO REPLY-QUEUE-NAME ``` Open Input Queue for Reading Date Requests-L_6: ```cobol 2300-OPEN-INPUT-QUEUE. MOVE INPUT-QUEUE-NAME TO MQOD-OBJECTNAME CALL 'MQOPEN' USING QMGR-HANDLE-CONN MQ-OBJECT-DESCRIPTOR MQ-OPTIONS MQ-HOBJ MQ-CONDITION-CODE MQ-REASON-CODE EVALUATE MQ-CONDITION-CODE WHEN MQCC-OK MOVE MQ-HOBJ TO INPUT-QUEUE-HANDLE SET REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN TO TRUE WHEN OTHER MOVE INPUT-QUEUE-NAME TO MQ-APPL-QUEUE-NAME MOVE 'INP MQOPEN ERR' TO MQ-APPL-RETURN-MESSAGE PERFORM 9000-ERROR PERFORM 8000-TERMINATION END-EVALUATE. ``` Open Output Reply Queue for Writing Date Responses-L_7: ```cobol 2400-OPEN-OUTPUT-QUEUE. MOVE REPLY-QUEUE-NAME TO MQOD-OBJECTNAME CALL 'MQOPEN' USING QMGR-HANDLE-CONN MQ-OBJECT-DESCRIPTOR MQ-OPTIONS MQ-HOBJ MQ-CONDITION-CODE MQ-REASON-CODE EVALUATE MQ-CONDITION-CODE WHEN MQCC-OK MOVE MQ-HOBJ TO OUTPUT-QUEUE-HANDLE SET RESP-QUEUE-OPEN TO TRUE WHEN OTHER MOVE REPLY-QUEUE-NAME TO MQ-APPL-QUEUE-NAME MOVE 'OUT MQOPEN ERR' TO MQ-APPL-RETURN-MESSAGE PERFORM 9000-ERROR PERFORM 8000-TERMINATION END-EVALUATE. ``` Retrieve Next Date Request Message with Wait-L_8: ```cobol 3000-GET-REQUEST. MOVE 5000 TO MQGMO-WAITINTERVAL MOVE SPACES TO MQ-CORRELID MOVE SPACES TO MQ-MSG-ID MOVE INPUT-QUEUE-NAME TO MQ-QUEUE MOVE INPUT-QUEUE-HANDLE TO MQ-HOBJ MOVE 1000 TO MQ-BUFFER-LENGTH MOVE MQMI-NONE TO MQMD-MSGID MOVE MQCI-NONE TO MQMD-CORRELID ``` Retrieve Current System Date and Time-L_9: ```cobol EXEC CICS ASKTIME ABSTIME (WS-ABS-TIME) END-EXEC ``` Format System Date and Time into Readable Format-L_10: ```cobol EXEC CICS FORMATTIME ABSTIME(WS-ABS-TIME) MMDDYYYY(WS-MMDDYYYY) DATESEP('-') TIME(WS-TIME) TIMESEP END-EXEC ``` Construct Date and Time Reply Message-L_11: ```cobol STRING 'SYSTEM DATE : ' WS-MMDDYYYY 'SYSTEM TIME : ' WS-TIME DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO REPLY-MESSAGE END-STRING ``` Send Date/Time Reply Correlated to Original Request-L_12: ```cobol 4100-PUT-REPLY.
